queue.title: Price Checker · work queue
queue.intro: Requests come in on their own when the client submits the form. The clock starts at that submission, not at assignment.

empty.a_cotar_meus: You have no cases of your own being quoted.

empty.espera_cliente: No case waiting on the client.
empty.tudo: No request has come in through the Price Checker yet.
empty.fechados: No closed cases. A case is closed after issuance, with the button in the case header.

claimGate.title: This case has no owner yet
claimGate.waitingMiddle: has been in the queue for
claimGate.explainBefore: An offer written on a case with no owner can be overwritten by another agent working the same request, without either of them knowing. Claim the case and the composer opens — it is recorded as yours, with the time, and the case leaves
